listings.caption: This code builds an upper-triangular mask and uses masked_fill to replace the attention-score entries above the diagonal with negative infinity.
listings.code:
mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(context_length, context_length), diagonal=1)
masked = attn_scores.masked_fill(mask.bool(), -torch.inf)
print(masked)
listings.reason: The excerpt constructs an upper-triangular mask with torch.triu(..., diagonal=1) and applies masked_fill on attn_scores to set entries above the diagonal to -inf, exactly demonstrating the improved causal-masking approach described. The caption accurately describes what the code does.
